name: Domain Anchor: Limitless (Blue)

effects.name: attract_on_hit
effects.explanation: Blue pulls adjacent zombies toward the tower, clustering enemies for follow-up damage.

effects.name: space_warp_hit
effects.explanation: On hit, briefly warps target position, delaying advancement.

hollow_purple.name: Hollow Purple (Erasure)

effects.name: erasure_beam
effects.explanation: Purple erases matter on contact; the beam pierces through zombies dealing massive damage per tile.

hollow_purple.unlock_requirement: place Domain Anchor and defeat 25 zombies

effects.name: domain_zone
effects.explanation: Creates a guaranteed-hit domain zone; enemies inside are immobilized by infinite sensory input.

description: Anchors space around a chosen tile like the Limitless. Hits attract adjacent zombies inward, grouping them for team damage while slowing the front line. The Special Grade 'Strongest' barrier holds a chokepoint.
